description: Valid css served with Content-Type: text/html on the CDN: critical uses it as css.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. Rejecting text/html stylesheet responses is part of the soft-404 defence, even when the body happens to be css. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: "same host" must compare host:port, as the url() rebasing does, or be injectable.)
